caption:
The high ridges of Costa Rica are where two oceans meet in the air. Mountain biking in Costa Rica means moving along these high dirt roads, suspended between the damp Atlantic mist on one side of the spine and the dry Pacific breeze on the other. The climbs are long and unpaved, demanding patience from your legs and respect for the altitude. But once you reach the crest, the world opens up into endless green valleys that make the effort feel entirely quiet. Which ridge are you riding next?
